description.value: This masterfully crafted golden crown has three fire-red rubies embedded into it, each of them seems to shine with an inner fire. --- Kindle Intellect [one-action] (concentrate, manipulate) Effect One of the rubies goes dim. A flame of inspiration ignites the wearers intellect, granting him a +1 item bonus to intelligence for 10 minutes. --- The rubies regain their light at sunrise
